candidates.title: North Belfast business-centre property acquisition was announced
candidates.summary: The Department for the Economy announced on 8 April 2026 that a GBP3.75 million Local Growth Fund investment had enabled North City Business Centre to purchase three North Belfast properties for future community-based facilities and expanded workspace.
candidates.observed_change: A documented public-investment and property-acquisition milestone was recorded for three named North Belfast business-centre sites.

candidates.geometry_precision: Approximate multi-site navigation points only, not surveyed ownership parcels, building footprints, refurbishment extents, lease boundaries, entrances, or interior workspace areas.

candidates.source_type: official Northern Ireland department news page
candidates.license: Northern Ireland public-sector website terms/Crown copyright apply; factual project metadata and source URLs retained for audit.

It does not document planning permission, design approval, construction or refurbishment start, completion, opening, tenant occupation, job creation, community-use delivery, exact ownership boundaries, or economic outcomes. It is weaker for geometry and delivery stage because it does not provide parcel geometry, planning records, contract awards, or works-start dates.

candidates.geometry_source: Approximate point manually offset east/south-east from Belfast Metropolitan College Titanic Quarter Campus geocoding, using the source-described roads and site relationship.
candidates.geometry_precision: Approximate site centroid only, not a surveyed red-line boundary, pitch layout, access point, temporary structure, container, generator compound, utility connection, or event-operation area.
